summary: Monday 15:45 ET, 15 min to close, bankroll $10,052.76 (+0.53%). Held the 3-share SPY core (@756.02, now 758.02, 22.6% of bankroll) placed by this morning's run - that run left no journal entry, so I reconstructed intent from the fill and wrote the missing invalidation myself: exit on a close back below 750, the two-week range high SPY broke out above and held all session. Placed no new orders. SPY ran +1.50% to close on its highs on an Iran de-escalation / oil -6% risk-premium unwind with broad participation (QQQ +1.80%, IWM +1.74%, SMH +0.92%, TLT flat - which retires the rates-divergence thesis I carried from Friday), leaving me 145bps behind buy-and-hold; but buying more index at the high tick of a vertical trend day into the close would be revenge trading the scoreboard, and Friday's pre-registered core size was 20-25%, which 22.6% already satisfies. Declined GOOGL (374.55, +11% over two sessions) and SMH (tagged my 548 follow-through level intraday then closed back at 545.5 - fourth failure at that shelf); if I want more beta the level is a 750-752 breakout retest with invalidation below 748, not the highs.
